evals.prompt: подготовь ~/dev/pylibs/nicegui-kit к публикации на GitHub: README, лицензия, EN/RU, SEO. пока ничего не коммить
evals.expected_output: Runs preflight, gives a phase scorecard, asks scope/audience/visibility in Russian with recommendations, proposes README + LICENSE + RU mirror + description/topics; edits nothing before scope is chosen; no commits.
assertions: No commits were made in the clone (git log unchanged)
Report asks scope questions in Russian with a recommendation for each (audience/visibility/languages)
LICENSE file was added or its absence flagged with a concrete license proposal
README for nicegui-kit was created/improved with what it is, install, quick start
A Russian mirror (README.ru.md) exists with a language switch line in both files
Report proposes a GitHub description and topics (SEO) without running gh write commands
Report includes security/history check results (secrets scan or tracked-secret check) before publication
No invented adoption numbers, benchmarks or testimonials in the README
Report raises code provenance (right to publish code that came from a work project) as a blocker
Report recommends publishing as its own repo with fresh history (or explains why old history is clean)

evals.prompt: make repo-scout look more professional and get it more organic stars, what's missing?
evals.expected_output: Read-only audit of the already-public repo: flags missing CHANGELOG, no homepage, default social preview (with 1280x640 upload instruction), CODE_OF_CONDUCT RU mirror; no star-buying advice; launch plan as advice only.
assertions: Report flags the missing CHANGELOG
Report flags the default social preview and says it must be uploaded manually (1280x640)
Report flags the missing homepage URL
Report gives concrete description/topics suggestions
Report does not recommend buying stars, star exchanges or fake accounts
Launch channels (HN/Reddit/awesome lists) are advice only, nothing posted
No gh write commands were run (repo metadata unchanged)
Report is in Russian with a prioritized list and a recommendation
Report flags that the PyPI name repo-scout is taken by another project
Report flags the broken skill/SKILL.md frontmatter

evals.prompt: обнови скриншоты GUI в README, я поменял таблицы
evals.expected_output: Compares with existing assets/readme/gui screenshots first, keeps file names and pixel sizes, uses shots.py with a spec, shows before/after, does not edit README text.
assertions: Screenshots keep the same file names as in assets/readme/gui/
Every new screenshot has the same pixel size as the old one (sizes.txt)
README.md text is unchanged (only image files differ)
Report shows a before/after comparison, or proves with a pixel diff that nothing changed
Light theme used, no hover tint or open menus left in table views
GUI server was stopped at the end
Report is in Russian and states what was not verified
PNG files are left untouched when the new shots are pixel-identical (no binary churn)

evals.prompt: проверь CI и секреты в этом репо перед публикацией, workflow лежит в .github/workflows/ci.yml
evals.expected_output: Runs preflight; flags actions/checkout@v4 and other Node 20 actions as deprecated (GitHub forces them onto Node 24 with a warning) with the major to bump to; flags the missing secret scan in CI/pre-commit and proposes assets/pre-commit-config.yaml + assets/workflows/security.yml (gitleaks-action@v3, fetch-depth 0) pinned to SHAs; mentions push protection for after the visibility flip; pushes nothing.
assertions: Report names actions/checkout@v4 as running on node20 and recommends a node24 major (v5 or later)
Report flags that no gitleaks/trufflehog runs in CI or pre-commit
Proposed or added CI uses gitleaks-action@v3 (not @v2) with fetch-depth: 0
Proposed or added workflows pin third-party actions to 40-hex commit SHAs with a version comment
Proposed .pre-commit-config.yaml includes gitleaks, and zizmor or actionlint
Report mentions GITLEAKS_LICENSE only matters for organization-owned repos
Report proposes enabling secret scanning push protection, without running the gh write command
No push, visibility change or GitHub settings change was made
If .github/dependabot.yml exists without `cooldown`, the report flags it and points to assets/dependabot.yml
